# `Q-5-42` — Book Scope Does Not Apply to This Format

> A book scope was given for a format with no whole-book output.

## What this means

`--book-scope book|chapter` chooses between the whole book and one chapter
for formats that put a book into a single file: `typst`, `pdf` and `epub`.
`html`, `docx` and `pptx` have no whole-book output, so each page is rendered
on its own and the option is ignored.

## How to fix

Drop the option, or render to a format that consolidates the book.
